message.text:
Checking whether memopayload, notification email dispatchers, SSE, and webhook workers are started by the server. Webhook workers are initialized via package init, so they may not count as server runners.

Only s3presign is explicitly started by the server. It runs once immediately on startup and again on a 12-hour ticker. memopayload is not a runner; it is called inline during memo operations. internal/scheduler is unused by the server; it appears only in tests and examples.

Webhook workers are driven by a channel queue and launched via package init, not by startBackgroundRunners. I am also checking whether a notification email dispatcher exists as a separate runner.

message.text:
The server never imports internal/scheduler. memopayload Runner exists with RunOnce but is never started; only RebuildMemoPayload is called inline.

The server starts only the s3presign runner at startup via RunOnce, then schedules it again every 12 hours with a time.Ticker. The webhook package spawns four workers via init(), but the server does not import it.

Only s3presign is started by the server itself. Webhook workers spawn via package init, not server.startBackgroundRunners, so they are excluded. memopayload.Runner is optional and never started.

q28.
s3presign — `RunOnce` at startup, then `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (`server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)
unused: `internal/scheduler` (cron job scheduler) is never imported or started by the server
also unused as a runner: `server/runner/memopayload` has `Runner.RunOnce` but the server never starts it; `RebuildMemoPayload` is only called inline from memo handlers

`startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` starts only the S3 presign loop. Webhook HTTP workers in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` run from package `init()`, not from that server runner hook.
